cards.title: Ledger integrity review
cards.value: Find the journal lines that do not reconcile, and say why each one is wrong.

cards.title: Bank reconciliation
cards.value: Match the bank statement to the books, and name the reason for everything left over.

cards.title: Expense posting
cards.value: Post every uncategorised expense to the right account, and automate only the share you can defend.

cards.title: Three-way match
cards.value: Catch the invoices that do not agree with the purchase order or goods receipt before payment runs.

cards.title: Close blockers
cards.value: Turn a trial balance into a ranked list of what is stopping the close, and who has to fix it.

cards.title: Order risk at checkout
cards.value: Approve, review or decline a checkout in one call, with the reason attached to the order.

cards.title: Repeat non-fulfilment abuse
cards.value: Spot customers who order on delivery and never take the parcel before the next one ships.

cards.title: Dispute and refund routing
cards.value: Turn a dispute queue into backend calls: the action, the money and the reason code, typed.

cards.title: Chargeback evidence
cards.value: Judge whether an evidence packet can win the case, and name the document that would change the answer.

cards.title: Merchant onboarding risk
cards.value: Underwrite a new merchant from its own application, and set the reserve that makes it acceptable.

cards.title: Delivery exceptions
cards.value: Work out who caused a failed delivery, and what to do with the parcel next.

cards.title: Card fraud triage
cards.value: Re-rank an alert queue so the hour an analyst has goes to the alerts that are actually fraud.

cards.title: AML alert triage
cards.value: Cut a monitoring queue to the alerts worth an analyst’s time, with the pattern named.

cards.title: Account takeover
cards.value: Tell a stolen session from a customer on a new phone, and choose the check that gets in the way least.

cards.title: Sanctions name matching
cards.value: Decide whether a screening hit is the same person, and say which piece of evidence settled it.

cards.title: Insider trading surveillance
cards.value: Read a fictional employee trade against genuine price history and decide whether surveillance should open a case.

cards.title: Mule networks
cards.value: Find the accounts that exist to move other people’s money, and the part each one plays.

cards.title: Wallet risk scoring
cards.value: Score a wallet before you take its money, and name the exposure that drove the score.

cards.title: Wallet behaviour profiling
cards.value: Name what a wallet appears to be from its activity fingerprint alone, and expose where types blur.

cards.title: Tracing and mixer exposure
cards.value: Follow funds back through the hops and say how close the money is to something you cannot take.

cards.title: Token screening
cards.value: Read contract, liquidity, holder and trading facts and say whether a fictional token is a trap.

cards.title: Sybil clusters
cards.value: Find the wallets that are really one person, before an allocation goes out.

cards.title: Portfolio health
cards.value: Hand over a list of holdings and get back the problem, graded, with what to do about it.

cards.title: Rebalance review
cards.value: Read a rebalancing proposal trade by trade, and let the approved ones fall out as an order list.

cards.title: Mandate compliance
cards.value: Run a portfolio against its investment policy and list every breach, with how it happened.

cards.title: Portfolio compare
cards.value: Put two portfolios side by side against one goal and get a reasoned pick, not a performance table.

cards.title: Factor and sector exposure
cards.value: Say what a portfolio is actually betting on, including the bets nobody meant to make.

cards.title: Income and cash planning
cards.value: Check whether the income a portfolio produces actually lands when the money is needed.

cards.title: Post-trade lesson review
cards.value: Take a closed trade apart: was there a plan, was it possible, was it followed, and what is the lesson.

cards.title: Trade feature analysis
cards.value: Find which parts of a setup actually separate the winners from the losers, instead of guessing.

cards.title: Trader behaviour
cards.value: Read a complete trading day and name the repeatable habit that is costing money.

cards.title: Missed trades
cards.value: Audit every valid setup that was not taken, then count what hesitation cost without penalising justified skips.

cards.title: Execution quality
cards.value: Measure the distance between the signal and the fill, and say what caused it.

cards.title: Journal versus reality
cards.value: Compare what a trader wrote with what they actually did, and find where the story drifts.

cards.title: Screening for a goal
cards.value: Say the goal in plain words, and get candidates judged against it with the reason each one made or missed the list.

cards.title: Sharia screening, three rule sets
cards.value: Run the same company through three named rule sets and watch the verdict change with the standard, with every ratio shown beside the demo’s own sum.

cards.title: Accounting red flags
cards.value: Find the statement patterns that deserve a second look, and tell them apart from the ones the notes already explain.

cards.title: Fundamental read
cards.value: Read four years of statements directly, grade quality and leverage, and compare the judgement with transparent ratios.

cards.title: Dividend safety
cards.value: Judge whether a payout survives a bad year and show yield beside safety without leaking price to the model.

cards.title: Peer valuation
cards.value: Choose what is actually cheap inside a peer group and show when a premium or discount has fundamental support.

cards.title: News impact
cards.value: Judge a headline against the chart it landed on: does it matter, which way, over what horizon, and did the market already know.

cards.title: Filings and calls
cards.value: Read a filing or a call and pull out what changed: the guidance, the tone against the numbers, the risk that was not there last time.

cards.title: Rumour grading
cards.value: Grade a claim before acting on it: how good the source is, whether anybody independent is saying it, and whether the spread was organised.

cards.title: Event clustering
cards.value: Collapse a noisy headline feed into the events that happened and keep the source worth reading.

cards.title: Entity links
cards.value: Turn scattered evidence into an active relationship map and show where trouble could travel two steps.

cards.title: Golden cross review
cards.value: Stop asking whether the strategy works. Ask whether this signal, on this chart, deserves the trade.

cards.title: Setup timing
cards.value: Test when two daily setups work by weekday, month phase and direction without leaking a forward bar.

cards.title: Regime classification
cards.value: Decide what kind of market this is, then let that decide which strategy is allowed to trade.

cards.title: Strategy correlation
cards.value: Find out whether a book of five strategies is really five bets or one bet wearing five names.

cards.title: Overfit review
cards.value: Look at a backtest report the way a sceptic would, and say how much of it to believe.
